zh.title: Better MoA 设置
zh.intro: 预设表由你维护：预设、参考模型和聚合器都可增删改名。保存只写入 Host 设置，不会发起模型调用。
zh.loading: 正在读取 MoA 设置…
zh.unavailable: Host settings 尚未提供 better-moa。请确认插件已加载、配置支持实时设置并完成重载。
zh.clean: 已与 Host 设置同步
zh.saved: 已保存并核对 Host 返回值。
zh.savedByHost: 已由 Host 设置广播核对保存。
zh.awaiting: 已提交，等待 Host 确认…
zh.awaitingDetail: Host 尚未确认写入；草稿已保留，可稍后重新读取核对。
zh.external: Host 设置已被其他页面更新。为避免覆盖，请重新读取后再编辑。
zh.notWritable: 当前 Host 设置不可写。
zh.catalogFailed: 模型目录读取失败；已保存的路由仍会保留，可手动输入或刷新目录。
zh.catalogTimeout: 读取模型目录超时（页面可能处于后台或已冻结）；已保存的路由仍会保留，请刷新目录重试。
zh.catalogFailures: 部分 Provider 的模型目录读取失败。
zh.catalogEmpty: 模型目录为空，可手动输入 provider/model。
zh.catalogManual: 目录未就绪时手动输入；刷新目录后会改用完整选择列表。
zh.routeStale: 此路由不在当前模型目录中，仍会原样保留；保存不会静默替换。
zh.defaultPresetHint: 会话默认使用的预设；只能选择已启用的预设。
zh.noEnabledPresets: 当前没有启用的预设；请启用一个或删除全部预设。
zh.guardHint: 按实际规则检查参考输出：隔离伪造的工具记录与执行声称，不替代完整的提示注入防护。
zh.editPresetHint: 切换只改变编辑对象，不会改变默认预设或当前会话模型。
zh.sharedSchedulerHint: 判断器与阈值统一在上方通用设置中配置。
zh.reviewTimeoutHint: 仅用于“每轮会话开始和结束”的结束前审阅；1000–120000 ms，默认 60000 ms，留空恢复默认。
zh.fixedNote: 所有参考始终并行发起请求，界面不再提供并发、排队或调度模式。Host 统一限制：单参考默认 600 秒、参考阶段截止默认 900 秒（1–1800 秒，不含聚合器）。
zh.presetsIntro: 预设 id 创建后保持稳定；保存写入完整预设表，未在界面展示的提示词等高级字段会原样保留。
zh.presetsEmpty: 还没有预设。新增一个预设，添加参考模型并选择聚合器后即可保存。
zh.presetDescriptionHint: 仅用于展示，不影响调用。
zh.lastPreset: 至少保留一个启用的预设；要清空配置请删除全部预设。
zh.every_n: 每 N 轮工具迭代
zh.fanoutHint: 参考模型何时被调用：每轮开始；每 N 轮工具迭代；智能调度（由小模型或 JEV 判断阶段完成时介入）；每轮开始和结束（结束前再审阅一次，主模型据此修改一轮）。
zh.aggregatorEffortHint: 跟随 = 不指定，沿用会话模型选择框的 effort；选择具体档位会固定写入聚合器。
zh.aggregatorEffortUnsupported: 当前聚合器模型未公开 reasoning effort，只能跟随会话模型选择框。
zh.aggregatorEffortUnknown: 当前聚合器路由不在模型目录中，无法确认支持的 effort；跟随不受影响，选择具体档位前请先刷新目录。
zh.schedulerTitle: 调度判断器（所有预设共用）
zh.schedulerHint: 在每次工具迭代后，用便宜的模型判断是否刚完成一个小阶段；判断失败时按最长间隔兜底。
zh.schedulerOpenaiHint: 两种 OpenAI 方式共用下面的环境变量。Decisions 返回介入概率；Responses 返回结构化判断。
zh.schedulerCacheHint: 30 分钟缓存；共享前缀至少 1024 tokens 才可命中。历史窗口移动或改写会降低命中率。
zh.schedulerJevCacheHint: JEV 暂未公开缓存断点和命中计数，不能显示可靠的命中率。
zh.schedulerEnvInvalid: 请输入有效的环境变量名，不要填写密钥。
zh.schedulerApiKeyEnvHint: 只填环境变量名，不要填密钥本身
zh.schedulerGapHint: 1–999 轮工具迭代；判断失败时到最长间隔强制介入。
zh.schedulerStateCharsHint: 100000–512000，默认 128000。保留早期背景、当前用户要求和近期记录；按区间轮换。字符数不等于 token 数，长输入会增加费用和延迟。
zh.schedulerRouteRequired: 智能调度的小模型必须填写 provider/model
zh.schedulerGapInvalid: 智能调度的最少间隔不能大于最长间隔
zh.noReferences: 没有参考模型；该预设会直接由聚合器回答。
zh.injectionSerial: 串行：等待该参考意见后继续
zh.injectionParallel: 并行：主循环继续，意见下一步注入
zh.injectionHint: 只决定意见何时进入主对话；所有参考始终同时并行发起请求，二者不是同一层。
zh.effortUnsupported: 该模型未公开 reasoning effort；保存时不会发送已存的值。
zh.effortUnknown: 该路由不在目录中，无法确认支持的 effort；原值会保留。
zh.maxTokensHint: 留空 = 使用模型默认值；面板不套用固定通用上限，仅在填写时要求正整数。
zh.advancedHint: 以下字段通常无需修改；留空表示沿用 Host 默认。
zh.persistentHint: 是否把该参考的检查点持久化；自动表示沿用 Host 策略。
zh.continueOnStop: 会话停止时是否继续执行；自动表示沿用 Host 策略。
zh.cacheScopeHint: 标记参考请求的缓存范围；留空表示不指定。
zh.systemSuffixHint: 追加到该参考系统提示的词条；留空表示不追加。
zh.sessionPolicyHint: 稳定：上下文重建后仍复用同一会话 id，缓存命中更多；轮换：每次重建换新会话，与 0.8.0 一致；自动：按路由决定（保存时不写入该字段）。
zh.routeRequired: 聚合器和启用的参考必须填写 provider/model，且 provider 不能是 moa
zh.defaultDisabled: 默认预设必须存在且已启用
zh.noPresets: 至少启用一个预设，或删除全部预设以清空配置
zh.fanoutInvalid: 咨询节奏只能是每轮开始、智能调度、每轮开始和结束，或 1–999 的每 N 轮工具迭代
zh.agentEffortInvalid: 聚合器固定使用的 reasoningEffort 不在该模型支持的档位中
zh.aggregatorEffortRequired: 该聚合器模型没有公布 reasoning effort，无法固定档位；请改为跟随会话模型选择框
zh.maxTokensInvalid: maxTokens 必须留空或为正整数
zh.reviewTimeoutInvalid: 结束前审阅超时必须留空或为 1000–120000 ms 的整数
zh.invalidId: 预设或参考 id 必须是稳定的 ASCII 标识（字母/数字开头，可含 . _ -）
zh.duplicateId: 预设或参考 id 不能重复
zh.unverified: Host 已响应，但返回设置与提交值不一致；草稿已保留，请重新读取核对。
zh.credentialPlaceholder: 输入新密钥；不会回显已保存值
zh.credentialNotConfigured: 尚未在 DSH 凭据存储中配置；仍可使用同名环境变量。
zh.testSuccess: 连接成功，已发现模型目录。
zh.testNeedsKey: 测试已保存密钥以外的端点时，请先输入新密钥；密钥不会写入设置。
zh.testCatalogSuccess: Provider/model 已在 DSH 模型目录中。
zh.testCatalogFailure: Provider/model 不在当前 DSH 模型目录中。
zh.decisionApiHint: 留空使用 Host 默认；仅测试时转发给 discoverModels。
zh.decisionModelRequired: HTTP 决策模型必须填写 model 和 Base URL
zh.decisionBaseURLInvalid: Base URL 必须是有效的 HTTP(S) 地址
zh.noDecisionWarning: 已启用 smart 预设，但未配置决策模型：smart 节奏将只按 maxGap 强制触发。
zh.confirmNoDecision: 仍有 smart 预设。停用决策模型后只按 maxGap 调度，确认继续？
zh.deliveryWait: 等待全部参考模型（或超时）后一次注入
zh.deliveryBackground: 后台收集，汇齐（或超时）后在下一步一次注入
zh.presetReferenceTimeoutHint: 1–1800 秒；留空使用全局值。超时参考会在单次注入中列为不可用。
zh.contextWindowHint: 8192–10000000；留空由目录或 billion-context 拒绝信息自动学习。
zh.referenceTimeoutInvalid: 预设参考超时必须为 1–1800 秒的整数
zh.contextWindowInvalid: 上下文窗口必须为 8192–10000000 的整数或留空

en.title: Better MoA settings
en.intro: You own the preset table: presets, reference models and aggregators can be added, renamed or removed. Saving writes Host settings only; it never starts a model call.
en.unavailable: Host settings does not serve better-moa yet. Check that the plugin is loaded, its config supports live settings, and the client has reloaded.
en.saved: Saved and verified against the Host response.
en.savedByHost: Save confirmed by a Host settings broadcast.
en.awaitingDetail: The Host has not confirmed the write yet. Your draft is preserved; reload to verify later.
en.external: Host settings changed in another surface. Reload before editing again to avoid overwriting that change.
en.notWritable: The current Host settings document is read-only.
en.catalogFailed: The model catalog could not be loaded. Saved routes are preserved; enter them manually or refresh the catalog.
en.catalogTimeout: Loading the model catalog timed out (the page may be in the background or frozen). Saved routes are preserved; refresh the catalog to retry.
en.catalogFailures: Some providers failed to return their model catalogs.
en.catalogEmpty: The model catalog is empty. You can enter provider/model manually.
en.catalogManual: Manual input while the catalog is unavailable; refresh to get the full picker.
en.routeStale: This route is not in the current catalog. It is preserved verbatim and never replaced silently.
en.defaultPresetHint: Preset used by default in a session; only enabled presets are selectable.
en.noEnabledPresets: No preset is enabled. Enable one, or delete every preset to clear the table.
en.guardHint: Applies the actual rule set to reference output: fabricated tool records and execution claims are isolated. Not a complete prompt-injection defense.
en.editPresetHint: This only selects the editor; it does not change the default preset or the current session model.
en.sharedSchedulerHint: Configure the shared judge and thresholds in General settings above.
en.reviewTimeoutHint: Only for the review at the start-and-end cadence: 1000–120000 ms, 60000 ms by default. Clear to restore the default.
en.fixedNote: References are always dispatched in parallel; concurrency, queueing and scheduling are no longer configurable here. The Host applies one timeout for a reference (default 600 s) and a reference-phase deadline (default 900 s, 1–1800 s, aggregator excluded).
en.presetsIntro: A preset id stays stable once created. Saving writes the complete preset table; prompt and other advanced fields that are not shown here are preserved verbatim.
en.presetsEmpty: No presets yet. Add one, attach reference models and choose an aggregator, then save.
en.presetDescriptionHint: Presentation only; does not affect calls.
en.lastPreset: Keep at least one preset enabled; delete every preset to clear the table.
en.user_turn: At the start of each turn
en.user_turn_end: Start and end of each turn
en.fanoutHint: When the reference models are called: at the start of each turn; every N tool iterations; smart scheduling (a small model or JEV decides when a phase is complete); start and end of each turn (one more review before the turn ends, and the main model gets one more revision round).
en.aggregatorEffortHint: Follow means no override: the session model picker decides the effort. Picking a level pins it on the aggregator.
en.aggregatorEffortUnsupported: The selected aggregator model advertises no reasoning efforts, so it can only follow the session model picker.
en.aggregatorEffortUnknown: The aggregator route is not in the catalog, so effort support is unknown. Following is unaffected; refresh the catalog before pinning a level.
en.schedulerHint: After every tool iteration a cheap model decides whether a small phase just completed; when a judgement fails, the longest gap forces one.
en.schedulerOpenaiHint: Both OpenAI modes share the environment variable below. Decisions returns intervention probabilities; Responses returns a structured judgement.
en.schedulerCacheHint: 30-minute cache; a shared prefix needs at least 1024 tokens. Moving or rewriting the history window reduces reuse.
en.schedulerJevCacheHint: JEV does not publish cache controls or counters, so its hit rate cannot be measured reliably.
en.schedulerEnvInvalid: Enter a valid environment variable name, not the API key.
en.schedulerApiKeyEnvHint: Environment variable name only, never the key itself
en.schedulerJevModelHint: Decision model name; jev-latest by default.
en.schedulerThresholdHint: 0.05–0.95; the closer to 1, the less often it intervenes.
en.schedulerGapHint: 1–999 tool iterations; after a failed judgement the maximum gap forces one.
en.schedulerStateCharsHint: 100000–512000; default 128000. Retains early context, the current user request and recent records, rotating in coarse windows. Characters are not tokens; longer input costs more and may take longer.
en.schedulerTimeoutHint: 1000–120000 ms; a timeout counts as "not now".
en.schedulerGapInvalid: The minimum gap cannot exceed the maximum gap
en.noReferences: No references; the aggregator answers directly for this preset.
en.injectionSerial: Serial: wait for this advice, then continue
en.injectionParallel: Parallel: keep looping, inject at the next step
en.injectionHint: Only controls when advice enters the main conversation. Every reference is still dispatched in parallel; these are different layers.
en.effortUnsupported: This model does not advertise reasoning efforts; a stored value is not sent on save.
en.effortUnknown: This route is not in the catalog, so effort support is unknown; the stored value is preserved.
en.maxTokensHint: Blank = the model default; the panel applies no fixed universal cap and only requires a positive integer when set.
en.advancedHint: Usually unnecessary. Blank means the Host default applies.
en.persistentHint: Whether this reference checkpoint is persisted. Auto follows the Host policy.
en.continueOnStop: Whether this reference keeps running when the session stops. Auto follows the Host policy.
en.cacheScopeHint: Marks the cache scope of reference requests; blank means unspecified.
en.systemSuffixHint: Text appended to this reference’s system prompt; blank means none.
en.routeRequired: Aggregators and enabled references require provider/model; provider cannot be moa
en.defaultDisabled: The default preset must exist and be enabled
en.noPresets: Enable at least one preset, or delete every preset to clear the table
en.fanoutInvalid: The cadence must be the start of each turn, smart scheduling, the start and end of each turn, or every N tool iterations with N from 1 to 999
en.agentEffortInvalid: The aggregator's pinned reasoningEffort is not one of the levels this model advertises
en.aggregatorEffortRequired: This aggregator model advertises no reasoning efforts, so a level cannot be pinned; follow the session model picker instead
en.maxTokensInvalid: maxTokens must be blank or a positive integer
en.reviewTimeoutInvalid: The review timeout must be blank or an integer from 1000 to 120000 ms
en.invalidId: Preset and reference ids must be stable ASCII identifiers (letter/digit first; . _ - allowed)
en.duplicateId: Preset and reference ids must be unique
en.unverified: The Host responded, but its returned settings differ from the submitted values. Your draft is preserved; reload to inspect it.
en.credentialPlaceholder: Enter a new key; saved values are never echoed
en.credentialNotConfigured: Not configured in the DSH credential store; a same-named environment variable can still be used.
en.testSuccess: Connection succeeded and returned a model catalog.
en.testNeedsKey: Enter a fresh key to test this endpoint. Keys are never written into settings.
en.testCatalogSuccess: Provider/model is present in the DSH model catalog.
en.testCatalogFailure: Provider/model is not present in the current DSH model catalog.
en.decisionApiHint: Blank uses the Host default; forwarded to discoverModels only for the test.
en.decisionModelRequired: HTTP decision models require model and Base URL
en.decisionBaseURLInvalid: Base URL must be a valid HTTP(S) URL
en.noDecisionWarning: A smart preset is enabled without a decision model: smart cadence will use maxGap-only scheduling.
en.confirmNoDecision: Smart presets are still enabled. Without a decision model they use maxGap-only scheduling. Continue?
en.deliveryWait: Wait for all references (or timeout), then inject once
en.deliveryBackground: Collect in background; inject once at the next step when complete (or timed out)
en.presetReferenceTimeoutHint: Integer 1–1800 seconds; blank inherits the global value. Timed-out references are listed as unavailable in the single injection.
en.contextWindowHint: 8192–10000000; blank uses the catalog or values learned from billion-context refusals.
en.sessionPolicyHint: Stable reuses one session id after a context rebuild (more cache hits); Rotate starts a fresh session per rebuild, matching 0.8.0; Auto follows the route and is saved by omitting the field.
en.referenceTimeoutInvalid: Preset reference timeout must be an integer from 1 to 1800 seconds
en.contextWindowInvalid: Context window must be blank or an integer from 8192 to 10000000
